Name: CSS' Harvey Cares - A Harvey Marriage Expansion
Author: ClairesStoryofSeasons
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sX6CPFQ0/introduction.png[/img]

Are you one of the hopeless romantics who adore Doctor Harvey and romance him in your saves? Do you stack hundreds of coffee beans just to woo one of Pelican Town’s oldest bachelors? Are you craving more of his awkward yet lovable charm?  Often overlooked by most players, are you that[i] someone[/i] who thinks Doctor Harvey deserves more love from the community? If it's all 'yeses' across the board, then this mod was made for you. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/dQzv1Y85/harvey-cares-3.png[/img]

[b][i]Harvey Cares [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img][/i][/b] is a marriage expansion that speaks for itself. It brings Harvey’s best traits to the forefront: his kindness, his devotion to the community, and his caring love, not made through grand gestures but through his everyday kindness. This mod contains more than 100+ marriage dialogue lines that bring out Harvey’s inherently caring nature as a spouse and as a pillar of Pelican Town. Harvey Cares attempts to make him more complete and true to what players already admire from him the most (+ the perks). 

[i][img]https://i.postimg.cc/4NMqXJdH/little-boi.png[/img] This mod features:[/i]
[list]
[*][b]100+ new marriage dialogue lines[/b] from Harvey  (including new additional bonus lines with RSV installed) 
[*]Various perks of marrying and loving our caring town physician (check your mail every 6th day of the season, folks!)
[*]New lines from villagers around town who react to your marriage and relationship with Harvey. Your marriage and impact on Harvey do not go unnoticed! 
[*]Compatibility with other mods (see Compatibility section)
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: This mod utilizes GNMT if you have the mod installed and have a preferred pet name from your spouse, which will reflect in his dialogue. This mod is also gender-neutral and may be used by farmers of all genders and sexual orientations.

Disclaimer: As the mod description and the title aptly describes it, this is a [b]MARRIAGE expansion[/b]. All of the perks and dialogue lines will be reflected [u]once your farmer is married to the farmer[/u].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/TPLf9k4B/installation.png[/img]

This mod requires Content Patcher 2.7.0 or higher versions. Download the ZIP file and extract its contents into your Mods folder.

[b]Disclaimer[/b]: Under the circumstance that you downloaded the mod through Vortex and it did not unpack correctly, I recommend downloading the mod MANUALLY. Ensure that all required files are installed and the mod file is properly extracted to your mod folder. For other issues, include your SMAPI log (+and any important info) so that I may know how to address your problem.
﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UPgjnDU.png[/img]

[list]
[*]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28624]Harvey Attends Aerobics[/url]﻿. When installed, some of his dialogue lines are altered to fit his new schedule.
[/list][list]
[*]This mod is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23365]Shy Harvey[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32138]Plus Alive Harvey[/url]﻿. If either or both of these other mods are installed, you may set the value settings to [b]Random[/b] (via GMCM or manually editing it in the config.json). This basically tells the game to flip a coin for either Harvey Cares or these mods' lines to appear when dialogue keys overlap. 
[/list][list]
[*]Is this compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿? Also yes! You can set 'CFE_Harvey' to "random" in the config, thereby allowing both mods to coexist without issue.
[/list]
In general, when dialogue mods that edit the same keys (e.g., "spring_1" dialogue) conflict, only one set will appear in-game, typically whichever mod loads last. Setting the value to [b]"Random"[/b] helps balance this and gives both sets of lines an equal chance to appear when this conflict occurs. Why choose when you can enjoy them all? [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img]

(Disclaimer: Keep in mind that outside this selection, this mod might conflict with other dialogue mods that alter Harvey’s marriage dialogue.) 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nh9PS6nK/supported-languages.png[/img]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35345]Harvey Cares Chinese Translation[/url] (Mandarin)﻿
[/list]
For mod translators, I am open to having my mods translated, provided that you [b]ask permission[/b] first. For inquiries, you may directly message me on Nexus so you can get my Discord (preferably).

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FKZgTZkg/future-plans.png[/img] 

This mod mainly utilizes dialogue and mail to expand on Harvey as a spouse and as an important figure in Pelican Town. Future updates will include discounts from the Clinic when passing out (when found by Harvey) [b][color=#00ffff](now added in ver. 1.0.1)[/color]. [/b]I plan on implementing a perk wherein dying in the Skull Caverns will also prevent the player from losing items, with a discounted price in their surgery costs. See you in ver. 1.0.2!

Feel free to share your suggestions. Stay tuned! 

In the meantime, you can check out my other works here:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26598]Sweeter than Pomegranates[/url]﻿ - An Elliott Marriage Dialogue Expansion Mod
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26825?tab=description]Good Luck, Haley![/url]﻿ - A Haley Pre-Marriage Dialogue Expansion (for our sapphic farmers, with an upcoming 2.0 on the horizon)
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nz32hkHc/credits.png[/img]
